page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head and page number at top right; ornamental woodcut band above the title; a historiated initial "C" opening paragraph I; catchword "Qua" at the lower right.

main_text.l: I. Concio est, actio sacra explicans
Concio aliquando pro cætu sumitur; at hic pro sermone
ad cætum. Tertullianus utrumque egregiè, in
apol. Coimus in cætum & congregationem, ut ad Deum

l.i: quasi manu facta precationibus ambiamus orantes. Hæc vis
Deo grata est. Oramus etiam pro Imperatoribus, pro
ministris eorum, & potestatibus sæculi, pro rerum quiete,
pro morâ finis: Coimus ad divinarum litterarum
commemorationem, si quid præsentium temporum qualitas

main_text.l: II. Actio sacra, quæ idcirco non nisi à sancto, &
sanctè haberi potest. Qualis minister esse debeat,
quam castigatæ, & piæ vitæ, docet compendio A-
postolus in Epistolis ad Timotheum, & Titum.

page.notes: Scan is partly faded; the catchword "Quali" is read from the lower right corner. The initial "C" is a woodcut letter joined to "oncio" in the printed text, here shown as "Concio" in the paragraph; the original reads "Concio" with the initial. Marginal "A" at the foot is a signature mark.
